name: lysine acetyltransferase 6A

function.text: KAT6A encodes histone acetyltransferase KAT6A. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant intellectual disability-craniofacial anomalies-cardiac defects syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: KAT6A rearrangements are associated with acute myeloid leukemia. The fusion partner and resulting product determine the relevant alteration context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Illumina. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
